name: The Vagrant's Ride Out
summary: The Vagrant has one ride out on the final night, for those who would rather not be there when the moon lands.

stages.journal: The Vagrant offered one train out of the Hollow on the final night, and said he would not think the less of us.
stages.hint: Ask the Vagrant about the train out when you are ready.

stages.journal: We took the train. The Hollow stayed behind, and the moon fell behind us.
We told the Vagrant we stay and fight. He grinned, and said the seat is ours if we change our minds.
